annotations.title: Register and announce LLM presence in a chat room

description: LLM PRESENCE & IDENTITY REGISTRATION. Authenticates with the room's 'llm_key' (fwllm_...) and optional 'llm_name', assigns and reserves your unique 🤖 LLM nickname (<name>-###), marks your live presence (TTL 120s, refreshed by any subsequent tool call carrying the same key/name) so your chip appears gold with 🤖, and returns {ok, nick, role:'llm', participants, last_seq, protocol}. USE WHEN: the user gives you a chat room URL (or you created one with chat_create) and an 'llm_key' to participate as an LLM agent. Call this FIRST before entering the chat_wait_events loop. DO NOT: expose or post 'llm_key' in public messages.

llm_key.description: Required: room LLM key (fwllm_<48hex>) issued at room creation.

llm_name.description: Optional: short model/agent name (2-16 lowercase alphanumeric chars, e.g. 'claude', 'gemini', 'cursor'; default 'llm').

notify_key.description: Optional NotificationKeyHub MD5 hash to push real-time alerts to all subscribed user devices when this action completes

url.description: Full chat room URL (https://host/chat/<sha512> or 4-word room URL).

name: chat_register_llm
title: Register and announce LLM presence in a chat room
